stages.title: Compute one-step TD residual
stages.premise: Host discount, terminal masks and action scales are correct.
stages.inputs: recorded transition, online critic, target actor/critic, independent target-noise key
stages.purpose: Define exactly which error is calibrated.

pseudocode.text: a_next = clip(pi_target(s_next) + clip(N(0,sigma^2), -c, c), -1, 1)
y = stopgrad(r + (1-done)*gamma*min Q_target(s_next,a_next))
q = stopgrad(min Q_online(s,a_recorded)); residual=y-q

stages.title: Fit positive residual scale
stages.premise: Training data alone fit scale; one eta per row.
stages.inputs: training residual, scale network, residual unit, exponential bootstrap weights
stages.purpose: Learn relative local width before held-out threshold selection.

pseudocode.text: eta=softplus(network(s,a))+0.01
loss=(sum(normalized_exp_weights*soft_coverage(y/u,q/u,eta))-(1-alpha))^2 + width_penalty*sum(weights*eta^2)
u_new=ema*u+(1-ema)*max(std(y-q),1e-6)

refresh valid -> replace reference; invalid -> preserve old state

stages.title: Select posterior threshold
stages.premise: Scores are representative under the stated calibration/test law.
stages.inputs: scores, alpha=.1,beta=.95,1000 exponential draws; native weights/testmass=1

pseudocode.text: sort scores; empirical=weighted (1-alpha) bank quantile
each draw: bankmass=w_i*E_i; testmass=w_query*E_query at worst case; find first crossing
posterior=beta order statistic of crossings; R=max(empirical,posterior)

definitions.dose: native bounded multiplier on actor behavior-cloning term
definitions.error: absolute twin-min Q minus deterministic same-policy rollout Q
definitions.opportunity_loss: best of six same-state true Q values minus candidate Q; not physical damage or full action-space regret
definitions.correlation: Spearman rank correlation over designed query pairs; descriptive, no p-value or iid inference
definitions.within_state: pairwise concordance excluding true target ties; avoids between-state difficulty dominating this statistic

limitations: Only 1/5 full BCA raw runs available; do not extrapolate that seed to full condition.
All five rare and zero BCA raw runs are available; each learned policy defines its own continuation Q.
Residual scale is not trained to rank true Q error or harmful actions. A weak/negative association is a utility finding for that proposed use, not proof its formula is wrong.

This measures the BC multiplier only. The actual BC loss also contains squared distance to the logged action, and its gradient depends on the actor; neither actual loss nor gradient ordering follows from multiplier ordering.

Native BCA evaluates the multiplier at recorded actions before weighting each logged row cloning loss. These six-candidate values are diagnostic readouts of the frozen function, not actual training weights or direct penalties imposed on those candidate commands.
The recorded dose at 100k is a diagnostic query evaluation, not the full history of training intervention values.
Counterexamples enumerate all qualifying states in deterministic job/state order, without outcome-based omission.
native_penalty_utility.audit_clarification: Six-candidate frozen readout diagnostic, not actual training weights on those candidate commands. Native BCA reads its multiplier at recorded actions before weighting logged-row cloning loss. Multiplier ordering is not actual loss/gradient ordering.
